<!-- pr-reviewer: 47e43ffa382ebf92fcb308dfd681892bac638a5c -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge**

What looks good
- Test-only change: against current main the PR adds one file, `crates/sim/tests/fixture_mesh_convict.rs` (#476 is already merged). No product code, no build.rs, scripts, `.github/` or dependency changes.
- Gate-map header and provenance line are present. The 5 tests cover the claimed cases: strict dip on a mesh top, rotated fixture, overhanging arm, the #424/#425 repros on a closed mesh, and a seeded 12,000-move sweep.
- Body is complete: `Changelog: none (test-only)`, `Refs #339` (partial work, so it correctly does not close), and #491 is filed separately.

Local results (merged with current main 97661c8b, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test fixture_mesh_convict` | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --tests -- -D warnings` | clean |

Requested before merge
- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking)
- The new file is about 300 lines, under the ~400 limit.
- I did not re-run `fixture_mesh` or `fixture_stack_span`, because the diff does not touch them.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
